summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of equity securities by Ares Core Infrastructure Fund in its monthly closing for May 2026. The fund agreed to sell multiple classes of common shares for an aggregate purchase price of $712.6 million, with the per-share price based on net asset value as of April 30, 2026. No underwriting discounts or commissions were paid. This is a routine capital raise by a closed-end fund under Rule 506(b)/Regulation S, not a special situation transaction.
